integrity: Exact matrix/covariance derivation with reproducible standard-library rational tests; no third-party full text embedded. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-dimensional scalar bilinear benchmark with fixed Gaussian marginals, iid noise pairs and freely chosen within-pair coupling. Reused or swapped second noise is not conditionally unbiased at its adaptively selected evaluation point. The result does not extend automatically to arbitrary finite-sum, nonlinear or multi-mode oracles.
title: Sharp oracle-coupling reversal for noisy two-step slingshot descent-ascent
